$comment: ADR 0141: one joined, uncleared DM per person in the list, search and Start chat. SDK adapters mark only joined isDm rooms with a known peer and no active clear marker eligible. Choose the greatest latest-event timestamp; missing timestamps rank last. Equal timestamps use ascending room ID so SDK iteration order cannot change the selected room. Never delete rooms or combine histories. Apply unread/name filters after selection from all eligible local DMs for the person.
